pending_interview.category: Case/product sense — client scoping walkthroughs, articulating tradeoffs out loud, build-vs-buy reasoning
pending_interview.question: You are in an early scoping conversation with a new enterprise client. They are a logistics company with about 4,000 employees. Their head of operations tells you they want to "use AI to improve their routing and dispatch process" — the system that assigns drivers to deliveries and plans the most efficient routes. They currently use a legacy software tool from a vendor, and their contract with that vendor expires in eight months. They have a small internal data team of three analysts, no ML engineers, and a moderate but not unlimited budget. Walk me through how you would scope this engagement: what questions you would ask, what information you would need before recommending any technical direction, and how you would think through whether to build a custom AI solution, extend or replace the existing vendor tool, or recommend something else entirely. What are the key tradeoffs you would be weighing out loud?
